skillsbench-task-solver.name: skillsbench-task-solver
key_points: Do NOT run `solution/` scripts — write your own outputs. Running provided solution scripts does not satisfy the task.
Do NOT claim task complete until deliverables exist in the task tree — in-container or Docker-only pytest is not sufficient. The host verifier runs on staged outputs from this directory.

Do NOT create or modify `tests/conftest.py` to override file paths for local testing — the conftest is picked up by the host verifier's test run inside the Docker container where paths differ from the host. If local verification is neede...

skillsbench-video-clip-extraction.name: skillsbench-video-clip-extraction
key_points: ffmpeg concat requires matching codecs: All clips must use the same codec. Re-encode each clip with `-c:v libx264 -c:a aac` before concatenation. Don't try to concat raw cuts with `-c copy` — container formats may differ.

Clip buffer matters: Extract slightly more than the exact word duration (0.2–0.3s buffer on each side) so clips contain audible content. Too-short clips (exact word duration) may produce 0-length segments.
